# Contributing to WishPilot

First off, thank you for considering contributing to WishPilot!

## Intellectual Property & Author Attribution

WishPilot is an original software application designed, architected, and maintained by **Vishwjeet Singh Vilkhu** ([@vishwjeet27](https://github.com/vishwjeet27)).

By submitting a Pull Request or contributing code to this repository:
1. You agree that your contributions will be licensed under the **GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0-or-later)**.
2. You acknowledge and preserve the original copyright and authorship of **Vishwjeet Singh Vilkhu**.
3. Any forks, derivative works, or redistributions MUST maintain prominent author attribution, include the full GPL-3.0 license text, and remain fully open-source.

## How to Contribute
1. Fork the repository on GitHub.
2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`).
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`).
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`).
5. Open a Pull Request with a clear description of your changes.

## Code of Conduct
Please maintain a respectful, constructive, and professional environment for everyone.
